DTR · TALK ABOUT A SCENE

The Butterflies Land First

STS-MS8-L3-13001400-MSVPA-SOC-LAT-01 • MS Visual and Performing Arts Music Grade 8 • Refining Music Using Evaluation Criteria
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
Every fall, millions of monarch butterflies travel from Canada and the United States down to the fir forests of Michoacán, in Mexico, where people have welcomed their return with music for generations. Room 12 is writing the score for a short film about that journey, and their first take came out too fast, because the drums finished before the butterflies ever landed. So the band listened again, checked their criteria board, and decided to slow the drums and let the marimba ring longer underneath them.
If you were scoring the moment the butterflies finally land, what sound would you choose so the audience feels that they made it?
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
1
What is Marisol doing?
Look at the picture. Explain what Marisol is doing and why that line matters, in two sentences. Use exact words, not "stuff."
2
What is Paloma holding?
Look at the picture. Explain what Paloma holds and its purpose in the music, in two sentences. Name it exactly.
3
What is the teacher doing?
Look at the picture. Explain what the teacher is doing and why it helps the band, in two sentences.
4
What place is this? How do you know?
Look at the picture. Explain what place this is and your evidence, in two sentences. Name exact clues.
5
Tell me about the criteria board.
Look at the picture. Explain what the board shows and what the marks tell the band, in two sentences. Use exact nouns.
6
Tell me about what Camila is wearing.
Look at the picture. Explain what Camila wears and what her hand is doing, in two sentences. Use exact words.
Record an answer for each question, then submit.
Content alignment: MU:Cr3.1.8b — Describe the rationale for refining a work by explaining choices based on evaluation criteria. ELD (Speaking — official ELPAC “Talk About a Scene”): PI.A.1, PII.B.3, PII.B.4, PII.B.5.
